function viaFalse(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (isText === false) return x.toUpperCase();
  return x.toFixed(1);
}

function mutableAlias(x: number | string): string {
  let isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (isText === true) return x.toUpperCase();
  return "n";
}

function comparedItself(x: boolean | string): string {
  if (x !== true) {
    const rest: false = x;
    return `rest ${rest}`;
  }
  return "true";
}

console.log(viaFalse("a"), mutableAlias("b"), comparedItself("c"));
